requirements.requirement_text: Users shall be able to add a new Todo item to a specified List.
The system shall trim leading and trailing whitespace from a Todo item title before saving it during creation or editing.
The system shall reject a Todo item title that is empty or contains only whitespace after trimming during creation or editing.
requirements.conditions: ['title is empty or whitespace only after trimming']

requirements.requirement_text: The system shall reject a Todo item title longer than 100 characters during creation or editing.
Users shall be able to toggle a Todo item between active and completed status.
Users shall be able to enter Todo item edit mode by double-clicking the item label.
Users shall be able to update the title of an existing Todo item.
The system shall delete a Todo item when the edited title is saved as empty after trimming.
The system shall cancel editing and keep the original title when the user presses Escape.
Users shall be able to delete a single Todo item.
Users shall be able to use a single control to mark all Todo items in the current List as completed or active.
requirements.actions: ['mark all items as completed or active']
requirements.expected_results: ['all todo items in list have specified status']

requirements.requirement_text: Users shall be able to filter Todo items by All, Active, and Completed status.
Users shall be able to clear all completed Todo items in the current List at once.
requirements.expected_results: ['all completed items are removed from list']
